learnings: Tool reliability matters: API failures and LLM response errors can cause incomplete coverage, leading to inconclusive verdicts even when no security issues exist
When multiple models encounter tool errors on the same files, it may indicate file content issues (e.g., encoding, size limits) that should be investigated
A single complete review with no errors can be more valuable than multiple incomplete reviews - prioritize models that successfully complete their analysis
For binary packages with pinned checksums from official upstream sources, the primary risk is in maintainer scripts and helper utilities, which should be prioritized in review
